structural_assessment: Not structural. No entity added, no ownership moved, no plane created, no classification downgraded. FoodSafetyRegistration gains a field and the event register records a state transition — both within an existing entity owned by an existing context. Nothing propagates to foundational-solution-architecture.md.
constrained_by_foundational: The Cycle 0 invocation decided ownership, classification and planes. This invocation is bound by DAT-1.1, DAT-3.2 and DAT-6; none was reopened.

changes.content: FoodSafetyRegistration gains register_reason — the competent authority's rejection reason, stored verbatim. Classified Regulated Evidence / Confidential, inheriting the entity's 6-year retention (ES3) and approved PII region (ES9).
changes.rationale: The field is stored on a Regulated Evidence entity and is supplied by a third party, so its content cannot be predicted: a register may return a reason naming an individual, a premises address or a commercial circumstance. Classifying it as Internal because 'it is just a status message' would be a guess about someone else's data.
changes.handling_rule: Passed through to the producer verbatim; never logged, never included in an outbound notification body, never replicated.

changes.content: identity.registration.verified transitions Planned -> Active on merge of this cycle. Deduplication key recorded as (producer_id, fbo_number, verified_on) — the business act.
changes.rationale: Active means the producing feature has landed. The transition is written here but takes effect at Phase 7.5 merge; recording it as Active now would assert a capability that does not exist until the PR lands.

changes.content: No read model registered. The current-status projection LLD-F01 raises is NOT created at Cycle 1. Decision trigger recorded as DAT-PEND-04.
changes.rationale: A projection of the latest FoodSafetyRegistration row would be a replicated attribute needing a DAT-6 entry with a staleness budget — and the honest staleness budget for an eligibility decision is zero, which is another way of writing 'read the source'. At Cycle 1 volumes an index satisfies the 250 ms budget. Creating a projection now would add a replication DAT-C2 must police, to solve a performance problem nobody has measured.
changes.trigger: DAT-PEND-04 — revisit when registration history per producer exceeds a depth at which the indexed read misses the INT-4.3 p95 <= 250 ms budget in a production-shaped environment.

changes.content: DAT-PEND-04 — current-status projection for FoodSafetyRegistration. PENDING. Trigger: the indexed read on the append-only history misses the INT-4.3 p95 <= 250 ms budget in a production-shaped environment.
changes.rationale: A deferral with a trigger, not a silence. PRIN-01-C1 checks that every pending decision has one.

changes.content: DAT-C1, DAT-C2 and DAT-C3 unchanged and re-evaluated against the amended document. All three still pass: Identity remains the sole writer of FoodSafetyRegistration; no read model was registered and none is held; register_reason carries classification, retention and residency.

physical_schema_boundary.note: LLD-F01's other half — the index — is physical schema and does NOT appear in data-architecture.md. It is emitted in db-schema.sql. The canonical document records the access pattern and the budget it must meet; the index that satisfies it can change without the architecture changing.

guardrails.gr-L1-pii-detection: pass_with_note — register_reason is an unbounded third-party-supplied string on an entity that already holds PII. The detector cannot classify content it has not seen, which is why DATD-01 classifies it defensively. Flagged for the Phase 5 security review.
